verdict.rationale: Docs say ChatGPT and Codex first load each skill's name and description, then pull in the full SKILL.md when they decide to use that skill. SKILL.md requires a `description` field, and the skill creator explicitly asks when the skill should trigger. Codex also auto-discovers `.agents/skills` from the working directory up to the repo root, and a community user reports agents are good at using skills when needed. Missing for 10: in-depth guidance on writing descriptions so the right skill triggers, and hands-on evidence of how accurately skills activate (one community critique calls skills prompt-and-pray but cites no concrete failure).
